theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), (∀ η : TestFormOn U (m + 1), T η = tauAction (m + 1) M θ ξ η) → ∀ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (μ' : Measure (Eucl P)) (v' : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) m), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → IsMeasureRepresentation T.boundary μ' v' → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn U m) (ψ : Eucl P → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ → ∫ x in M, θ x * ξ x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((fderiv ℝ ψ x).smulRight ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x))) ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)) = (∫ x, ψ x * v' x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x) ∂μ') - (∫ x, ψ x * v x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x) ∂μ)
